3806.body:
## Why
Prevent repeated corner-size mistakes. Product corners must be 0, 2 or 4px.
Ticket: https://app.hypertask.ai/detail/project-15/9611

## Change
- Reject arbitrary rounded utilities and radius-property overrides except `0`, `0px`, `2px`, `4px` and `var(--radius-...)`.
- Recommend `rounded-[2px]` / `rounded-[4px]`. The existing chat radius tokens are theme-dependent; no `--radius-sm` / `--radius-md` tokens exist.
- Add a generated per-file baseline, range-ordered overflow reporting, and a baseline-aware plugin hash.
- Freeze **302 raw radius violations in 156 files**, including legacy large-radius utilities previously covered by bulk suppressions. The earlier 216 reported findings were not the raw total.
- Remove overlapping/stale bulk allowances (forbidden-utility budget 166 -> 63). Do not change `src/`.
- Generate with `node scripts/generate-radius-baseline.mjs`; test the total can never exceed 302. Generator is idempotent.

## Proof
- 26 related tests pass; changed JS/CJS/MJS files pass ESLint. Full-repository ESLint also passes (0 errors, 22 warnings). The push hook passes without bypass after warming its lint cache.
- Full `src/` ESLint passes with the repository suppression arguments: **0 errors, 13 warnings**. Original `origin/production` also has 0 errors and the same 13 warnings: 11 location-assignment, 1 alt-text, 1 incompatible-library. Locations and messages match after normalizing checkout paths.
- Build the Lever produced rerunnable generation/proof scripts; Test Behavior, Not Implementation led to added-violation, valid-value, per-file and bulk-suppression interaction tests.
- Reproduce with `node scripts/prove-radius-rule.mjs`. It materializes `git show <sha>^:<path>` snapshots in `/tmp` and lints them with allowance zero, without bulk suppressions.
```text
a51d88c970^:src/components/AI_CHAT/ChatWindow.tsx:44:9 Corners are 0, 2 or 4px only: use rounded-[2px] or rounded-[4px] instead of 'rounded-t-lg'. [hypertask-style/no-forbidden-utilities]
7b167459c5^:src/components/AI_CHAT/ChatWindow.tsx:24:9 Corners are 0, 2 or 4px only: use rounded-[2px] or rounded-[4px] instead of 'rounded-t-lg'. [hypertask-style/no-forbidden-utilities]
7b167459c5^:src/components/AI_CHAT/ChatWindow.tsx:46:7 Corners are 0, 2 or 4px only: use rounded-[2px] or rounded-[4px] instead of '[.amoled_&]:rounded-[5px]'. [hypertask-style/no-forbidden-utilities]
2be3533f8f^:src/components/RTE/Extensions/resizableMedia/ResizableMediaNodeView.tsx:19:8 Corners are 0, 2 or 4px only: use rounded-[2px] or rounded-[4px] instead of 'rounded-lg'. [hypertask-style/no-forbidden-utilities]
2be3533f8f^:src/components/RTE/Extensions/resizableMedia/ResizableMediaNodeView.tsx:44:5 Corners are 0, 2 or 4px only: use rounded-[2px] or rounded-[4px] instead of 'rounded-[5px]'. [hypertask-style/no-forbidden-utilities]
2be3533f8f^:src/components/RTE/Extensions/resizableMedia/ResizableMediaNodeView.tsx:387:13 Corners are 0, 2 or 4px only: use rounded-[2px] or rounded-[4px] instead of 'rounded-lg'. [hypertask-style/no-forbidden-utilities]
2be3533f8f^:src/components/RTE/Extensions/resizableMedia/ResizableMediaNodeView.tsx:403:13 Corners are 0, 2 or 4px only: use rounded-[2px] or rounded-[4px] instead of 'rounded-lg'. [hypertask-style/no-forbidden-utilities]
60dd0ed907^:src/components/AI_CHAT/ChatWindowFrame.tsx:94:7 Corners are 0, 2 or 4px only: use rounded-[2px] or rounded-[4px] instead of 'rounded-[5px]'. [hypertask-style/no-forbidden-utilities]
6423aae593^:src/components/PageComponents/Kanban/KanbanSectionComponents/section.tsx:65:7 Corners are 0, 2 or 4px only: use rounded-[2px] or rounded-[4px] instead of 'rounded-[5px]'. [hypertask-style/no-forbidden-utilities]
6423aae593^:src/components/PageComponents/Kanban/KanbanSectionComponents/section.tsx:67:12 Corners are 0, 2 or 4px only: use rounded-[2px] or rounded-[4px] instead of 'rounded-[5px]'. [hypertask-style/no-forbidden-utilities]
5/5 parent versions flagged; allowance=0; snapshots=/tmp/htpr-9611-proof-BA0L3M
a51d88c970: rounded-t-lg is flagged, but the corrected var(--radius-chat-window) override is allowed by the requested token exemption.
6423aae593: both rounded-[5px] skeleton classes are flagged; SCSS declarations are outside this JSX utility rule.
```
No parent snapshot is missed. Coverage limits: `a51d88c970` flags an unrelated `rounded-t-lg`, not the corrected theme-token override, which the requested token exemption allows. `6423aae593` flags its two skeleton utilities, but SCSS declarations are outside this JSX rule.
Worker has no board login; the orchestrator must post the ticket update. Auto-merge stays off; do not merge.

Release notes

engine.io@6.6.13

The ws dependency was bumped to ^8.23.0 following GHSA-37g9-w4hg-h9qr.
